title: Fix QA CI failures blocking release (analysis total parity, receipt mismatch warning)

acceptance_criteria.outcome: For the same month, the Dashboard hero's 'My expenses' total equals the Analysis combined total (personal + every group share, whatever the group's status: active, archived or deleted). Web fixed; mobile Home already showed total_expenses and was correct (its unused helpers are aligned).
The web Dashboard hero's 'I paid' lens counts what the user paid in every group (any status), from the server-computed spend_breakdown.i_paid_share. Mobile has no I-paid lens.
The groups strip and per-group summaries still list only active groups the user is an active member of.

In the desktop New expense dialog, a scanned receipt's item controls (Remove item, price, name) can be activated after the dialog content grows (for example several group chips), in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
The QA regression matrix (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) passes on the release candidate in CI.

A new expense defaults to the person's local calendar date (not the UTC date) on web Quick Capture, the full expense form and quick logging, and recurring start dates / due checks on web and mobile — so it is never flagged as a future date in the evening west of UTC.

notes: User authorization (chat, 2026-11-22): 'fix the QA failures and re-run'. Covers fix, checks and push of the fix; release still needs separate candidate authorization.
